basic.name: Leave It to Me!
basic.description_template: Deals Ice DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.

variants.name: Together, We Script Tomorrow!
variants.description_template: Consumes 1 stack of "Epic" to dispel all Crowd Control debuffs  on Mem. Trailblazer and Mem launch a Joint ATK , dealing Ice DMG to all enemies equal to {{scaling1}}% of Trailblazer's ATK and {{scaling2}}% of Mem's ATK respectively. Then, Mem gains 10% Charge.

skill.name: I Choose You!
skill.description_template: Summons the memosprite Mem. If Mem is already on the field, restores Mem's HP by an amount equal to {{scaling1}}% of Mem's Max HP, and grants Mem 10% Charge.

talent.name: Almighty Companion
talent.description_template: Memosprite Mem has an initial SPD of 130 and a Max HP equal to {{scaling1}}% of Trailblazer's Max HP plus {{scaling2}}. For every 10 Energy regenerated by all allies in total, Mem gains 1% Charge.

technique.name: Memories Back as Echoes
technique.description: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for 10 second(s). Enemies within the Special Dimension are placed in a Time Stop state, halting all their actions. After entering battle against enemies afflicted with the Time Stop state, delays the action of all enemies by 50%, and then deals Ice DMG to all enemies equal to 100% of Trailblazer's ATK. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

ultimate.name: Together, Mem!
ultimate.description_template: Summons memosprite Mem. Grants Mem 40% Charge, then makes Mem deal Ice DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Mem's ATK to all enemies.

memosprite_skill.name: Baddies! Trouble!
memosprite_skill.description_template: Deals 4 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Ice DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Mem's ATK to one random enemy. At the end, deals Ice DMG equal to {{scaling2}}% of Mem's ATK to all enemies.

variants.name: Lemme! Help You!
variants.description_template: Advances the action of one designated ally by 100% and grants them "Mem's Support," lasting for 3 turn(s). For every 1 instance of DMG dealt by a target that has "Mem's Support," additionally deals 1 instance of True DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of the original DMG. When using this ability on this unit, cannot trigger the action advance effect.

memosprite_talent.name: Friends! Together!
memosprite_talent.description_template: Increases all allies' CRIT DMG by an amount equal to {{scaling1}}% of Mem's CRIT DMG plus {{scaling2}}%. If the Charge has yet to reach 100%, Mem automatically uses "Baddies! Trouble!" when taking action. When the Charge reaches 100%, Mem immediately takes action. In the next action, can select one ally and use "Lemme! Help You!".

variants.name: Go, Mem, Go!
variants.description: When Mem is summoned, immediately gains 50% Charge.

variants.name: No... Regrets
variants.description: When Mem disappears, Trailblazer's action advances by 25%.

2.name: Rhapsode's Scepter
2.description: When the battle starts, Trailblazer's action advances by 30%. When Mem is first summoned, grants Mem 40% Charge.

4.name: Petite Parable
4.description: When using "Baddies! Trouble!," Mem immediately gains 5% Charge.

6.name: Magnets and Long Chains
6.description: When the Max Energy of an ally target that has "Mem's Support" exceeds 100, for every 10 excess Energy, additionally increases the multiplier of the True DMG dealt via "Mem's Support" by 2%, up to a max increase of 20%.

major_traces.name: Unfinished Epilogue
major_traces.description:
After using Ultimate, gains 1 stack of "Epic," up to 2 stacks. When this unit has "Epic" and Mem is on the field, Basic ATK gets enhanced to "Together, We Script Tomorrow!"

Note: This Trace can only be unlocked when complete the Trailblaze Mission: "Fallen Petals, Leave Fading Traces of Fragrance".

eidolons.name: Narrator of the Present
eidolons.description: Increases the CRIT Rate of ally targets with "Mem's Support" by 10%. When an ally target has "Mem's Support," the effect of "Mem's Support" also applies to the target's memosprite/memomaster. This effect cannot stack.

eidolons.name: Gleaner of the Past
eidolons.description: When ally memosprites (aside from Mem) take action, Trailblazer regenerates 8 Energy. This effect can trigger a max of 1 time(s) per turn. The trigger count resets at the start of Trailblazer's turn.

eidolons.name: Chanter of the Future
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Dancer of the Muse
eidolons.description: When an ally target with 0 Max Energy actively uses an ability, Mem can also gain 3% Charge, and the multiplier of the True DMG dealt by this target via "Mem's Support" additionally increases by 6%.

eidolons.name: Seamster of the Ode
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10. Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Bearer of the Revelation
eidolons.description: Ultimate's CRIT Rate is set at 100%.
